propositions: Cut and publish rebar minor release version 0.11.0 with all version fields in pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock synchronized and released to PyPI with PEP 740 provenance bundle.
Release workflow requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id, full test/lint/typecheck/build validation, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes, and pypi environment approval before PyPI publish.
Published 0.11.0 wheel and sdist must verify using `uvx pypi-attestations verify pypi` against PyPI attestations store with publish/v1 predicate, not GitHub SLSA attestations.
Release must update GitHub Release tag v0.11.0, MCP Registry, and Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb to point to 0.11.0 sdist with matching SHA-256.
All acceptance criteria must be marked [operator-attested] for runtime/git/CI/external verification; initial close failure was due to missing attestation tags on 10 criteria, not artifact defects.
